signals.rationale: The speaker begins with the filler word 'Well' and repeatedly uses 'uh' while restarting his phrase. He also looks down and away briefly before completing his thought.
The speaker's frequent use of filler words and repetition of phrases indicate a lack of full commitment to his statement. His gaze shifts downward and away as he struggles to articulate his point.
The speaker nods his head and smiles warmly while the other person responds with 'Yeah, now you're talking,' indicating clear alignment with the statement.
The speaker delivers his statement fluently without any filler words or hesitation. He maintains an upright posture and steady eye contact while speaking.
The speaker's eyes widen and his eyebrows raise slightly as he delivers the hypothetical scenario, showing focused attention on the topic.
The speaker blinks frequently and swallows noticeably while delivering the initial part of his statement, displaying physical signs of tension.
